summary: Added operator-facing ecosystem explanation and projection surfaces that keep aom lifecycle visibility read-only and activation-gated.
acceptance_evidence: OperatorProjection now includes an ecosystem section with local registry status, aom lifecycle commands, staging root, activation authority and blocked prerequisites.
The projection explicitly reports activation_status=gated, staged_artifacts_active=false and staged_and_active_separated=true.
The projection declares resolver_owner=agent_core::ecosystem and agentd_resolver_logic=false.
The operator explain document defines schema fields, lifecycle flags, trust/advisory visibility and raw secret exclusions.

commands.summary: 6 operator projection tests passed, including ecosystem projection assertions.
Support bundle redaction and manifest test passed.

blocked_shortcuts: Operator projection does not stage or activate artifacts.
agentd does not own resolver or staging business logic.
The projection does not expose normal-mode shell.
Staged artifacts are not represented as active.
promotion_impact: Operators can see local ecosystem readiness and blocked activation prerequisites before runtime-mediated activation exists.
